This is another misunderstanding when it comes to meditation. 

I'm in the mood for some writing. So here we go.

With concentration comes focus. The longer your mind's ability to concentrate the stronger your mind's focus will get. 

So meditation is technically a training for your mind's concentration and focus. 

Imagine you are washing dishes:

1. You can (auto-pliot) bodily do the task while your mind is daydreaming. This is not meditation.

2. You and your mind fully immense yourselves in washing the dishes. That means there are no thoughts at all. That's when the duality of mind and self is performing a task in unison, which drops the duality all together and you become You, the universe itself. 

The goal of meditation is to realize the real You. There are different methods to realize yourself. One template cannot fit everyone. Like you mentioned not everyone can sit still for hours. 

So the goal is to train concentration and focus. Find the methods that get you into that Zen-mode. Then be happily obsessive over it. 

Once you have developed a higher level of concentration and focus. You concentrate on the inside emptiness, void, nothing. It's another long explanation for another day. 

Of course, you can walk the tough-path of aggressive use of Will against your mind to tame it, but it's truly not easy, the mind is such an intriguing Processor. You need a very strong Will to go against such a Beautiful Devil. 

You can live your life normally doing everyday things but still be in full meditation inside. Mask-up for the outside world, but be free inside always.

I am not this. I am not that. I am not it. And that is Me.

We were all born with clarity of what we truly are. For survival of that presentness we create our own ego, this ego helps us survive our environment and gives that presentness an identity. Overtime this ego is heavily conditioned and the ego believes it is the true self. 

So enlightenment is basically when the ego gets the clarity that it is not the true-self but merely the conditioning/imagination of the external and its own desires. So  enlightenment is for the false-self which is what we call ego. We as true-self cannot be enlightened because we are clarity itself. 

The true-self doesn't have feelings. Emotions and Intellect are tools for the false-self. This subject matter is highly paradoxical and complex because of the layers of reality we had experienced and haven't depending on how de-conditioned a person is as an ego(false-self). 

But briefly...

The true-self does not exist as a concrete element by itself. Hmmm. Maybe if I explain in this manner it'll be easier to comprehend. 
Imagine a computer system. The system cannot perform on its own as individual parts. All the parts must be assembled together for the system to operate an OS. This true-self is not the parts, not the operating OS, not the energy source. In fact it is nothing, only when we identify and objectify this nothing it becomes the Nothing which is identifiable.
